actions.expression: I search the keyed table for the id {string}
actions.description: Searches the keyed table by the first id.

actions.expression: I search the keyed table for the ids {string}, {string} and {string}
actions.description: Searches the keyed table by the three ids together.

actions.expression: I search the unordered table for the id {string}
actions.description: Searches the unordered table sequentially by id.
Checks that the keyed search found nothing and showed the given message.

actions.expression: the program SEARCH-EXAMPLE is ready with the test data
actions.description: Checks that the program under test is up and loaded with the test data.

actions.expression: the record found has the ids {string}, {string} and {string} and the name {string}
actions.description: Checks that the keyed search found the record with the given ids and name.
Checks the message of the sequential search.
